# Johnson Property Solutions

> Family-owned handyman and small-build business in Western Sydney. Two generations of tradesmen handle carpentry and decking, bathroom renovations, room additions and conversions, minor plumbing and home repairs across Penrith, Blacktown, Parramatta and The Hills.
> Free on-site written quotes. Public liability insured.

## Services
- Carpentry and decking — timber decks, pergolas, framing, custom built-ins: https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/services/#carpentry
- Room additions and conversions — extra rooms, garage and granny flat conversions, walls, plasterboard, doors: https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/services/#builds
- Bathroom renovations, managed end to end (waterproofing, tiling, vanities, fixtures): https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/services/#bathrooms
- Minor plumbing — leaking taps, mixer replacements, toilet repairs, small drainage: https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/services/#plumbing
- Home care and repairs — TV and mirror mounting, flat-pack assembly, sticky doors, plasterboard patching, painting touch-ups, gutter clearing, pressure washing, fence repairs: https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/services/#home-care

## Service area
Penrith, Blacktown, Parramatta, The Hills Shire and surrounding Western Sydney suburbs (NSW, Australia). https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/contact/#locations

## How pricing works
Priced by the job, not the hour. Free on-site visit, then a written quote; no call-out fee; deposit on larger jobs, balance on completion. Details: https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/faq/#pricing

## Contact
Phone 0400 123 456 (Mon–Fri 07:00–17:00) · info@johnsonpropertysolutions.com.au · https://timllz-huang.github.io/JohnsonHandyman/site/contact/
